entries.name: Narrandera Flora and Fauna Reserve

facts.claim: Narrandera Flora and Fauna Reserve, on the Murrumbidgee River a few minutes' walk from town, holds a koala colony of over 300 wild koalas descended from about 20 reintroduced in the 1970s; the regeneration project began in 1972.

A 1.5-hour self-guided walking track winds through river red gum forest and floodplain with views of Lake Talbot and the river; the Koala Track follows the canal to the Rocky Waterholes; First and Second Beach are river picnic spots; tracks are unsealed but flat and you can generally drive in, weather permitting.
NSW Government listing: Oakbank Drive, Narrandera Koala Regeneration Reserve; free entry; car park.
